flag_reading: A flag is kind:field:cause, and the field is the value whose status the flag describes, by its schemas/risk-scoring.yaml name: cvss_base, composite_score, severity_band, remediation_sla, risk_disposition, review_date, reachability.

The cause of a 'corrected' flag names the step that produced the field's new value: a changed cvss_base is 'vector', a changed composite_score is 'arithmetic', a changed severity_band is 'band-mapping' (or 'rounding' when only rounding moved the band), and a changed remediation_sla, risk_disposition or review_date is 'follows-band'. Where a fallback set the review date, 'baseline-date' or 'clock-restarted' replaces 'follows-band'. A change that the asset tags alone explain takes 'retagged' and the cause 'asset-tags' on every field it moves (ruling A). A finding carries at most one flag per kind and field.
A rounding-only composite difference is normalized and counted and never flagged: only a band that it moves is flagged, as severity_band:rounding.

basis 'pinned': the string is in the closed vocabulary of contracts/module-signatures.md, and a test requires it. 'optional': the renderer may add the flag or not, and a test accepts both. Only the flags on a value that the input's form lacks are optional, because the cause for those is open (S-12(b), named by T032).
A flag that the renderer adds and that is not listed is a defect of one side: the list is complete for the cases here.
notes: Every finding of run/threats.md is UNCHANGED and has a row in the baseline: the renderer carries all of them. Nothing is routed to the agent.
baseline/threats.md is the baseline run's file cut to Sections 2, 4c and 7 and the Affected Assets block. R-6's resolver needs it to exist; the scorer reads only baseline/risk-scores.md.
The baseline has no risk-scores.sarif, so a missing vector has no second source and stays missing.

Case 'bad-vector' stores a CVSS cell that its vector does not give, with the composite the right cell gives: one flag, no cascade. Cases 'cascade-composite' and 'cascade-band' store the composite that the wrong cell gives, so the correction moves the composite, and for 'cascade-band' the band: the composite and band flags are the ones that flag_reading's causes name.
Case 'rounding-only' stores the lower neighbour of an exact x.x5 composite, in the middle of a band: the difference is normalized and counted, never flagged (R-11).

Case 'resolved-wrong-composite': these two baseline rows belong to findings that Section 4c of the run lists as RESOLVED. R-30 keeps their last-known values verbatim, so the wrong composite is neither recomputed nor flagged; the row is marked resolved.
Case 'compound-label': Section 2 labels the zone 'Semi-trusted / Trusted', so the reachability range check is N17-dependent and is reported as unchecked, never as a violation (R-10).
Overrides: 'override-sla' and 'override-disposition' carry a human owner and a value that differs from the stored band's default; they are carried verbatim and flagged, and the review date is kept.

run.how: copy the scenario directory to a working directory and run from there: the front matter's baseline.source and every path here are relative to it

summary: S-4's seeded-error variant. A baseline written by the pre-fix scorer holds, for each of the 12 prefixes, a wrong composite, a wrong band, a CVSS score that its vector does not give, an out-of-range reachability under an unambiguous label and a missing vector, plus the documented exceptions as controls and the N17 cases. Every finding is UNCHANGED, so every one is carried and recomputed.
